Package com.sbancuz.offscreen.mixins.late

package com.sbancuz.offscreen.mixins.late
Optional ModularUI and HEI bridges selected after mod discovery. Accessors expose existing private state so scopes can save, substitute, and restore it on the client thread. Injection hooks route input, rendering events, and synchronized arrivals to the correct window. None of these classes should be instantiated directly.
